| extend VerCore = extract(@"^(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)", 1, SoftwareVersion)
| where isnotempty(VerCore)
| extend V = parse_version(VerCore)
| extend PreviewNum = toint(extract(@"preview0*(\d+)", 1, SoftwareVersion))

2751.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-54051: Network-AI: Improper Neutralization of Special
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("poc-316.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("poc-316.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2751.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-54051: Network-AI: Improper Neutralization of Special ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("poc-316.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("poc-316.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] GHSA-x8cv-xmq7-p8xp: PraisonAI AgentTeam.launch exposes unauth
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("poc_agentteam_launch_unauth.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,

| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/usr/bin/env") or FileName in~ ("poc_agentteam_launch_unauth.py"))

``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] GHSA-x8cv-xmq7-p8xp: PraisonAI AgentTeam.launch exposes unauth ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("poc_agentteam_launch_unauth.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem

description: Detects a python/uvicorn process running 'praisonai recipe serve' spawning a command or scripting interpreter, the code-execution outcome of reaching a tool-wired recipe through the fail-open auth middleware (GHSA-j4hj-7hfh-g2f4).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j4hj-7hfh-g2f4
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6rmh-7xcm-cpxj
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\uvicorn.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'praisonai'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  condition: selection
level: high
2819.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="python.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="python3" OR Processes.parent_process_name="pythonw.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="uvicorn.exe") (Processes.parent_process="*praisonai*" OR (Processes.parent_process="*recipe*" AND Processes.parent_process="*serve*")) (Processes.process_name="cmd.exe" OR Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe" OR Processes.process_name="bash" OR Processes.process_name="sh" OR Processes.process_name="wscript.exe" OR Processes.process_name="cscript.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2819.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\python.exe OR *\\pythonw.exe OR *\\uvicorn.exe) (@ParentCommandLine:*praisonai* OR (@ParentCommandLine:*recipe* AND @ParentCommandLine:*serve*)) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe)
2819.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(python|python3|pythonw|uvicorn)(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/[\\\/](cmd|powershell|pwsh|bash|sh|wscript|cscript)(\.exe)?$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2820.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] GHSA-4869-x4pr-q22x: PraisonAI: Unauthenticated RCE via Jobs A
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("yaml_parser.py", "workflows.py", "shell_tools.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("yaml_parser.py", "workflows.py", "shell_tools.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2820.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] GHSA-4869-x4pr-q22x: PraisonAI: Unauthenticated RCE via Jobs A ```

    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes

id: 7b2c3d4e-5f6a-4b7c-9d8e-0a1b2c3d4e5f
description: Detects a Node/npm/Bun process accessing developer credential stores (SSH keys, npm/docker/vault tokens, browser cookie DBs) consistent with the Atomic Arch Rust stealer.
references:
  - https://www.sonatype.com/blog/atomic-arch-npm-campaign-adds-malicious-dependency
  - https://ioctl.fail/preliminary-analysis-of-aur-malware/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/21
tags:
  - attack.t1552.004
  - attack.t1555.003
logsource:
  category: file_access
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/node'
      - '/npm'
      - '/bun'
      - '/pnpm'
  selection_file:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/.ssh/'
      - '/.npmrc'
      - '/.docker/config.json'
      - '/.vault-token'
      - '/.config/gh/hosts.yml'
      - '/.config/google-chrome/'
      - '/.config/BraveSoftware/'
      - '/.config/discord/'
      - '/.config/Slack/'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_file
level: high
2841.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*/.ssh/*","*/.npmrc","*/.docker/config.json","*/.vault-token","*/.config/gh/hosts.yml","*/.config/google-chrome/*","*/.config/BraveSoftware/*","*/.config/microsoft-edge/*","*/.config/discord/*","*/.config/Slack/*","*/.bash_history","*/.zsh_history") OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("id_rsa","id_ed25519","id_ecdsa","known_hosts","Cookies","Login Data")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.action Filesystem.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2841.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileOpenInfo ContextImageFileName=/\/(node|npm|bun|pnpm|npx)$/i
| regex("/(\\.ssh/|\\.npmrc|\\.docker/config\\.json|\\.vault-token|\\.config/(google-chrome|BraveSoftware|microsoft-edge|discord|Slack|gh)/|known_hosts|id_(rsa|ed25519|ecdsa))", field=TargetFileName)
| table([_time, aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName])

2842.sent:

2844.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Miasma and Hades Are Spreading Now: Detect Them on Developer Machines with Suspi
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2844.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Miasma and Hades Are Spreading Now: Detect Them on Developer Machines with Suspi ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

description: Detects creation of a '*-setup.pth' file in Python site-packages/dist-packages, the Hades worm's interpreter-startup code-execution hook that fetches the Bun runtime.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/miasma-and-hades-are-spreading-now-detect-them-on-developer-machines-with-suspicious-files
  - https://socket.dev/blog/shai-hulud-descends-to-hades-miasma-pypi-wave
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1546
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1059.006
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    FileName|endswith: '-setup.pth'
    FolderPath|contains:
      - 'site-packages'
      - 'dist-packages'
  condition: selection
level: medium
2848.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*-setup.pth" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*site-packages*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*dist-packages*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2848.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/-setup\.pth$/i
| regex("(site-packages|dist-packages)", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

status: experimental
description: An outbound HTTP request to a URL ending in .dtd/.xsl/.xslt, the resolution side-effect of an unhardened Saxon TransformerFactory in HAPI FHIR org.hl7.fhir.utilities.

2852.sigma:
title: Long-label DNS Query from Java Process (XXE Parameter-Entity OOB Exfil - CVE-2026-55471)
id: 2c3d4e5f-6a7b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: A DNS query from a Java process whose leftmost label is abnormally long, characteristic of XXE parameter-entity out-of-band exfiltration smuggling file contents into a subdomain.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2f55-g35j-5jmf
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1071.004
  - attack.t1041
logsource:
  category: dns
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\java.exe'
  selection_query:
    query|re: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{30,}\.'
  condition: selection_img and selection_query
falsepositives:
  - CDN / cloud telemetry hostnames with long hashed labels
  - DGA-style benign service-discovery names
level: medium
2852.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Resolution where nodename=DNS by DNS.src DNS.query
| `drop_dm_object_name(DNS)`
| eval leftlabel=mvindex(split(query,"."),0)
| where len(leftlabel)>=30
| where NOT match(query,"in-addr\.arpa$")
| sort - count
2852.falcon:

| regex("^[a-z0-9\\-]{30,}\\.", field=DomainName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())

status: experimental
description: Detects POST requests to Langflow's deprecated /api/v1/upload/{flow_id} endpoint, the vulnerable route in CVE-2026-55450 that allowed unauthenticated file upload leading to disk-exhaustion DoS and cache-path disclosure.

tags:

  condition: selection

| where req_count >= 3

2856.def:
// Server hosting Langflow (Windows or Defender-for-Endpoint on Linux)
let Lookback = 2h;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FolderPath has "langflow"                       // 'has' is case-insensitive -> Caches/.cache/Cache
| where FileName matches regex @"(?i)^[0-9a-f]{64}\."   // sha256-named upload artifact per PoC response
| summarize FileCount = count(), TotalBytes = sum(FileSize), DistinctFlowFolders = dcount(FolderPath), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), SampleFolder = any(FolderPath) by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where FileCount > 50   // >50 hash-named cache files in 10m from one process = flood
| sort by TotalBytes desc
2856.sent:

ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventType == "FileCreated"
| where TargetFilePath has "langflow"
| where TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)^[0-9a-f]{64}\."
| summarize FileCount = count(), TotalBytes = sum(TargetFileSize), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), SamplePath = any(TargetFilePath) by DvcHostname, ActingProcessName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where FileCount > 50
| sort by TotalBytes desc
2856.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count as file_count, sum(Endpoint.Filesystem.file_size) as total_bytes, min(_time) as firstSeen, max(_time) as lastSeen, values(Endpoint.Filesystem.file_path) as sample_paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Endpoint.Filesystem.action=created Endpoint.Filesystem.file_path="*langflow*" by Endpoint.Filesystem.dest, Endpoint.Filesystem.process_name span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| where file_count > 50   // burst of cache writes = disk-exhaustion flood, not normal single uploads
| sort - total_bytes

description: CurrentVersion\Run value data pointing to C:\ProgramData\Synaptics\Synaptics.exe, the DarkKomet persistence dropped by malicious Steam Workshop wallpapers under the genuine driver's value name.

  product: windows
detection:

level: high

2910.sigma:
title: Boot Manager EFI Write to EFI System Partition (CVE-2023-24932 Bootkit Downgrade)
id: 9d4a1f72-08be-4c63-bb15-7a2e6c0f9b31
description: Detects writes of bootmgfw.efi/bootmgr.efi/bootx64.efi to the EFI System Partition by a non-servicing process, consistent with a CVE-2023-24932 BlackLotus-style downgrade observed alongside SprySOCKS WIN_DRV.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/fishmongers-arsenal-upgraded-sprysocks-windows/
  - https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/how-to-manage-the-windows-boot-manager-revocations-for-secure-boot-changes-associated-with-cve-2023-24932-41a975df-beb2-40c1-99a3-b3ff139f832d
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1542.003
  - attack.t1553.006
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense_evasion
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\bootmgfw.efi'
      - '\bootmgr.efi'
      - '\bootx64.efi'
  filter_servicing:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\TiWorker.exe'
      - '\poqexec.exe'
      - '\CompatTelRunner.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_servicing
level: high
2910.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("bootmgfw.efi","bootmgr.efi","bootx64.efi") OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\EFI\\*") AND Filesystem.file_name="*.efi" AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("TiWorker.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","poqexec.exe","MoUsoCoreWorker.exe","CompatTelRunner.exe","wuauclt.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2910.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\bootmgfw.efi OR *\\bootmgr.efi OR *\\bootx64.efi OR *\\EFI\\* OR *\\bootmgfw.EFI OR *\\BOOTMGFW.EFI) -@Image:(*\\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\\TiWorker.exe OR *\\poqexec.exe OR *\\CompatTelRunner.exe)
2910.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\(bootmgfw|bootmgr|bootx64)\.efi$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(TrustedInstaller|TiWorker|poqexec|CompatTelRunner|wuauclt)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2911.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-53633: Vitest Browser: Exposed Browser Mode API Can P
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2911.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-53633: Vitest Browser: Exposed Browser Mode API Can P ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("node.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

| append [

       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

  - https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/security/advisories/GHSA-g8mr-85jm-7xhm

date: 2026/06/20

  - attack.t1546

  product: windows

      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\chromium.exe'
      - '\headless_shell.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
  selection_file:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\vite.config.ts'
      - '\vite.config.js'
      - '\vite.config.mjs'
      - '\vite.config.mts'
      - '\vite.config.cjs'
      - '\vitest.config.ts'
      - '\vitest.config.js'
      - '\vitest.config.mjs'

2979.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Wait, binding.gyp Can Do What? Exploring npm's Weirdest Build System
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js", "evil.js", "evil_script.js", "malicious.js", "evil.sh", "cc-evil.sh", "evil-wrapper.sh", "cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/dev/null", "/usr/bin/cc") or FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js", "evil.js", "evil_script.js", "malicious.js", "evil.sh", "cc-evil.sh", "evil-wrapper.sh", "cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2979.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Wait, binding.gyp Can Do What? Exploring npm's Weirdest Build System ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("index.js","node.js","evil.js","evil_script.js","malicious.js","evil.sh","cc-evil.sh","evil-wrapper.sh","cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/usr/bin/cc*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("index.js","node.js","evil.js","evil_script.js","malicious.js","evil.sh","cc-evil.sh","evil-wrapper.sh","cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2980.sigma:
title: Miasma Phantom Gyp - Python gyp parser spawning Node payload via binding.gyp
id: 7f3b6c2a-d4e1-4a01-9c5e-3a4f1c8e7b22
description: Detects node-gyp's Python parser (gyp.py) spawning unexpected child processes during npm install, indicative of GYP command-expansion abuse used by the Miasma v2 / Phantom Gyp worm (June 2026)
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/exploring-binding-gyp-npm-build-system
  - https://semgrep.dev/blog/2026/miasma-v2-self-spreading-npm-worm-now-uses-malicious-bindinggyp-file-and-compromises-57-packages/
  - https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/malicious-payload-in-ai-sdk-ollama-npm-package
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_python_gyp:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'gyp.py'
      - 'node-gyp'
      - 'binding.gyp'
  suspicious_child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  suspicious_child_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'index.js'
      - '__subclasses__'
      - 'catch_warnings'
      - 'echo stub.c'
      - "__import__('os')"
      - 'pymod_do_main'
  filter_compilers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cl.exe'
      - '\link.exe'
      - '\cmake.exe'
      - '\msbuild.exe'
      - '\gcc.exe'
      - '\clang.exe'
      - '\make.exe'
      - '\nmake.exe'
  condition: parent_python_gyp and (suspicious_child_image or suspicious_child_cmdline) and not filter_compilers
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate packages whose binding.gyp uses <!(node ...) for non-malicious build-time configuration (e.g. node-pre-gyp version probing)
  - Developers manually invoking node-gyp rebuild for native add-on debugging
level: high
2980.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("python.exe","python3.exe","python","python3") AND (Processes.parent_process="*gyp.py*" OR Processes.parent_process="*node-gyp*" OR Processes.parent_process="*binding.gyp*") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("node.exe","node","cmd.exe","sh","bash","dash","curl.exe","wget.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*index.js*","*__subclasses__*","*catch_warnings*","*/dev/null 2>&1*","*echo stub.c*")) AND NOT Processes.process_name IN ("cl.exe","link.exe","cmake.exe","msbuild.exe","gcc.exe","g++.exe","clang.exe","clang++.exe","make.exe","nmake.exe","ld.exe","tracker.exe","rc.exe","cvtres.exe","mt.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$"
2980.datadog: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@ParentImage:(*\\python.exe OR *\\Python.exe OR *\\PYTHON.EXE OR *\\python3.exe) OR @ParentCommandLine:(*gyp.py* OR *node-gyp* OR *binding.gyp*)) AND (@Image:(*\\node.exe OR *\\Node.exe OR *\\NODE.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\wget.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*index.js* OR *__subclasses__* OR *catch_warnings* OR *"echo stub.c"* OR *pymod_do_main* OR *__import__* )) AND -@Image:(*\\cl.exe OR *\\link.exe OR *\\cmake.exe OR *\\msbuild.exe OR *\\gcc.exe OR *\\clang.exe OR *\\make.exe OR *\\nmake.exe)
2980.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^python3?\.exe$/i
| ParentCommandLine=/(gyp\.py|node-gyp|binding\.gyp|gyp_main)/i
| (ImageFileName=/\\(node|cmd|sh|bash|dash|curl|wget|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/(index\.js|__subclasses__|catch_warnings|echo stub\.c|\/dev\/null 2>&1|__import__\('os'\)|pymod_do_main)/i)
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(cl|link|cmake|msbuild|gcc|g\+\+|clang|clang\+\+|make|nmake|ld|tracker|rc|cvtres|mt)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentCommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
